title: The four Kumbh Mela locations: Prayagraj, Haridwar, ...
script: You've probably never heard this about Kumbh Mela. Prayagraj's Kumbh is considered the largest, held at the sacred Sangam - the confluence of the Ganga, Yamuna, and the mythical Saraswati river. Each location hosts the full Kumbh roughly once every 12 years, meaning any single site sees it only a handful of times in a lifetime. Kumbh Mela rotates between four sacred rivers: the Ganga at Prayagraj and Haridwar, the Shipra at Ujjain, and the Godavari at Nashik. That's the story of Kumbh Mela - faith, history, and scale like nowhere else on Earth.
